verdicts.A_stop_resume_discipline: RESOLVED (human confirmed 2026-10-07) — the second resume relied on the standing 'Continue until completion' authorization; the human confirmed it covered the externally interrupted-cell rerun. The campaign's measured stop was correct in all cases
verdicts.B_reuse_integrity: SOUND — raw-output, frozen-input and snapshot hashes support reusing completed qualification cells; re-slicing was unnecessary
verdicts.C_cell16_handling: SOUND — whole-cell rerun, preserved interrupted baseline and matching cross-mode hash avoid mixed-attempt qualification
verdicts.D_measurement: FLAWED — measurement and arithmetic are correct, but reducers did not enforce timed-row cell/mode identity
verdicts.E_verifier_honesty: FLAWED — checkout verification had false-pass paths; the retained regression log establishes six tests, not the claimed seven
verdicts.F_evidence_completeness: SOUND — the bounded DROP is re-derivable and the final seal is intact
verdicts.G_operational_resilience: FLAWED — non-atomic checkpoints and insufficient interruption/process-ownership checks defeated the claimed recovery guarantee
verdicts.H_restoration_integrity: SOUND — production inputs, archived artifacts, distributions, registry and corrected helper hashes match

summary: No BLOCKER or HIGH findings. Bounded measured DROP remains supported; the identified method and evidence weaknesses do not establish that the completed result is wrong.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Independent re-reduction reproduces the DROP: 6 pairs, 0 excluded, wall median delta +0.5053315 s (+2.1414973%), CPU delta +4.0859375 s (+2.7816724%), zero candidate wins.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Retained DROP; no additional cells run.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Second-stop resume cites 'same continuing authorization' rather than a fresh post-stop human response.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED BY HUMAN 2026-10-07: the human confirmed ('Confirmed, drop is accepted') that the standing 'Continue until completion' authorization covered the externally interrupted-cell rerun after the harness session eviction. Only externally interrupted in-flight cells were rerun; no gate-failing cell was ever rerun. See drop-acceptance.json.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Timing-row identity was not bound to its declared cell (no mode/fixture/generator/supports/phase/run_id check); ordinary and accelerated outputs intentionally share hashes, so cross-mode substitution was not rejected by output digest alone.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: summarize() now validates the full cell tuple, phase and run-id prefix when a cell is supplied; validate_cell() and verify() pass the cell. New regression test relabels valid ordinary rows as accelerated and requires rejection (test_cross_cell_relabel_and_identity_mismatch_are_rejected).

findings_and_resolutions.finding: restored() did not cross-check validation.json outcome/freshness/manifest, and an empty sealed-evidence mapping made the loop vacuous.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: restored() now requires outcome == campaign recommendation, final freshness == restoration freshness, non-empty raw_manifest and sealed_evidence, and presence of a required evidence set before hash checks.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Checkpoints overwrote files non-atomically; --resume-authorized did not establish an external interruption and did not check for a completed decisive cell or process quiescence.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: manage.write() is now an atomic temp-file replace. campaign.run() adopts any complete (>=14 rows) unrecorded cell via validate_cell instead of discarding it, and before archiving a partial cell asserts the cell is not decisive-by-record and that no pnp_cli.exe is running.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The sealed regression log says 'Ran 6 tests'; the current suite has 8 (outcome-taxonomy + cross-cell tests added after the sealed run).
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: logs/reducer-regressions.log remains the frozen pre-campaign six-test log; logs/reducer-regressions-current.log records the supplementary post-campaign eight-test run and is explicitly labelled supplementary, not a rewritten seal.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: campaign_reducer_sha256 proves reduction-time identity, not pre-timing registration.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: campaign-as-run.py preserves the as-run reducer (sha256 e9926960c663e3d704c93f57c9490e0323c79cf20dd30aefa1dd08af3c32d333), and verify() pins that immutable copy rather than the hardened live reducer.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The stop-1 seal is a preserved manifest; five sealed paths changed contents afterwards.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: validation-stop1.json is retained and described as a historical manifest, not a currently executable seal.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Wording error: 'slower in 0 of 6' should be 'slower in 6 of 6'; the first timeout is 40 minutes (2400000 ms), not 45.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Corrected in REPRODUCE.md, ticket 57 and map.md. Measured numbers unchanged.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Restoration identities convincing; the separate-target helper correction was necessary and is not part of manage.py restore.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: production-driver-restoration.json records the correction and is part of the restoration procedure.
